title: Pokemon Card Hisuian Lilligant VSTAR RRR 008/067 S10D Japanese
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Pokémon card features the beloved character Hisuian Lilligant in a stunning holo foil finish. With a card size of Japanese and a vintage of no, this card is from the Arceus set and is a 1st edition. It has an HP of 130 and features the speciality of EX. 

The card is manufactured by Nintendo and illustrated by Hitoshi Ariga. It is perfect for collectors and fans of the Pokémon Trading Card Game. The card number is 050/078 and it is from the country/region of Japan. Don't miss out on the chance to add this incredible card to your collection!
